summary: Advises setting geography/behavior variables in inventory groups, site defaults in group_vars/all, location overrides in group_vars/<location>, host exceptions in host_vars, and role defaults to avoid undefined errors.
questions: Where should I set a site-wide default variable?
How do I override a group variable for a single host?

answer_card.title: Tips on where to set variables
answer_card.answer_md:
- Inventory groups for geography/behavior (child groups override parents; host vars override group vars).
- Site defaults in `group_vars/all`: `ntp_server: default-time.example.com`
- Location overrides in `group_vars/boston`: `ntp_server: boston-time.example.com`
- Host exceptions in `host_vars/xyz.boston.example.com`: `ntp_server: override.example.com`
- Role defaults in `roles/x/defaults/main.yml` to avoid undefined-variable errors.
